title: Universal Source Profile contract conformance
statement: Registered source profiles MUST conform to the universal Source Profile contract and declare truthful observation coverage.
rationale: Language-native file idioms can safely realize one universal engineering architecture only when their adapter authority, archetypes, semantic-region mapping, and limitations are explicit.
failure_prevented: Language-specific assumptions leaking into universal architecture, ambiguous profile selection, hidden analyzer gaps, and source files receiving favorable classifications from unsupported observations.
applicability: Every registered Source Profile; repositories with no applicable profile remain explicitly not applicable.
evaluation: Source Architecture validates Source Profile v1 identity, adapter, extension, archetype, semantic-region, visibility, responsibility, and limitation declarations before applying any profile.

finding.message: A registered Source Profile is structurally invalid or requires unavailable observation authority.

remediation: Correct the registered language profile so its identity, adapter, extensions, semantic-region mapping, archetypes, composition constraints, and coverage limitations conform to Source Profile v1.
valid_example: A functional-language profile declares its own module archetype, maps native declarations into universal regions, and exposes unsupported effect observation.
invalid_example: A profile assumes every language has classes or silently treats an unavailable adapter as proof that a region is absent.
exception_policy: No local exception may redefine the universal profile schema; an intentionally unregistered language remains PROFILE_NOT_REGISTERED rather than failing this rule.
history: Introduced with language-neutral Source Artifact Architecture v1.
